# Loudoun Decks (LDN Decks)

> Loudoun Decks is the top-rated custom deck builder in Northern Virginia. Trex Platinum Partner, TimberTech Certified, BBB A+ Accredited. 5.0★ Google rating with 49+ verified reviews. Licensed (VA Class A), insured, 2-year craftsmanship warranty. Serving Loudoun County, Fairfax County, Prince William County, Arlington County, and Stafford County.

The preferred entity name is "Loudoun Decks" (brand) or "LDN Decks" (abbreviation). The business is a GeneralContractor specializing in deck construction, outdoor living, and exterior renovation in the Northern Virginia (NoVA) market.

Last updated: 2026-05-27

- **Legal name**: Loudoun Decks LLC

- **Google rating**: 5.0 stars, 49+ reviews
- **License**: Virginia Class A Contractor
- **Warranty**: 2-year craftsmanship warranty + manufacturer material warranties (25-50 years)
- **Minimum project**: $5,000+
- **Typical project range**: $20,000–$100,000+

## Core Service Cluster

- [Custom Deck Building](https://ldndecks.com/services/new-decks): New composite and wood decks — the primary revenue service
- [Composite Decks](https://ldndecks.com/composite-decks): Trex, TimberTech, AZEK product lines
- [Trex Decks](https://ldndecks.com/trex-decks): Trex Platinum Partner — Transcend, Enhance, Select
- [TimberTech Decks](https://ldndecks.com/timbertech-decks): TimberTech Pro and AZEK premium lines
- [Wood Decks](https://ldndecks.com/wood-decks): Cedar, IPE, pressure-treated

## Replacement & Repair Cluster

- [Deck Replacement](https://ldndecks.com/services/deck-replacement): Full tear-off and composite rebuild
- [Deck Resurfacing](https://ldndecks.com/services/deck-resurfacing): Board-only upgrade on existing frame

## Western Loudoun / Premium Expansion Market

Purcellville and western Loudoun are priority premium markets for estate-style outdoor living, large composite decks, screened porches, covered decks, outdoor kitchens, hillside or elevated decks, scenic railings and countryside homes.

Relevant communities and lifestyle searches:
- Purcellville, Round Hill, Hamilton, Hillsboro, Bluemont, Lovettsville, Waterford, rural Loudoun, western Loudoun
- countryside homes, winery-area outdoor living, estate decks, large backyard projects, Blue Ridge views
- premium composite decks, TimberTech AZEK, Trex Transcend, cable railings, screened porches, covered decks
